retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, close-up portrait with asymmetric typography and hand-drawn yellow graphic accents typical of early 1990s pop music packaging.
triggerTerms: high-key portrait with yellow graphic accents
condensed sans-serif logo with speed lines

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-key photographic portrait of a subject with hands partially obscuring the face, featuring a grainy texture, a dominant white-to-black value range, and a pop of mustard yellow in a stylized graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's eye acts as the focal point through the fingers.
The top-left logo is balanced by the bottom-left title text.
The yellow graphic element provides a horizontal directional lead into the subject's hair.
coreInvariants: Grainy film texture across the entire image
High-contrast lighting with blown-out highlights on skin
Mustard yellow as the primary graphic accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye peering through fingers in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, follows the yellow graphic right to the eye, then drops down to the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space created by the subject's clothing in the lower-left quadrant.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with a single saturated graphic pop.

letterConstructionRules: Logo: Vertical elongation with rounded terminals and uniform stroke width.
Title: Humanist serif with organic, slightly irregular stroke weights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' in logo features a high crossbar.
The 'y' in the logo has a straight descender that aligns with the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a geometric, modern logo and a traditional, organic serif subtitle.
graphicDevices: Three-pronged yellow 'speed lines' or rays extending from the logo.
Small decorative fleur-de-lis or botanical ornament below the subtitle.

preserve: Ultra-condensed proportions of the top text
Mustard yellow color for the graphic accent
Stacked arrangement of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the specific early 90s condensed, rounded aesthetic.
Matches the calligraphic, slightly decorative serif feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, grainy film portrait of a person with short dark hair, hands partially covering their face with one eye visible. The lighting should be bright, blowing out details on the skin and white clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add an ultra-condensed white sans-serif logo in the top left with three mustard-yellow horizontal rays extending right. Add a black calligraphic serif title in the bottom left, stacked vertically, with a small black ornament underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the yellow accent specifically a mustard/golden hue?
Is the top-left text significantly more condensed than the bottom text?
Is the subject's eye the primary visual anchor?

adjustableVariables: Length of the yellow graphic rays
Degree of highlight blowout on the skin
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific brand name 'Keedy'
Do not replicate the exact hand-drawn rays; create a similar three-pronged graphic
Ensure the portrait subject is a generic representation rather than a specific celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-key exposure on the face.
Verify the mustard yellow color matches the 90s palette.
Ensure the ultra-condensed font doesn't lose legibility.
Confirm the grain doesn't obscure the focal eye.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key grainy portrait + ultra-condensed top-left logo + mustard yellow graphic accent + bottom-left stacked serif.
